title: A pending timer is progress; the deadlock is reported only after it has fired
purpose: Run a program that waits on a timer, then on an event nobody sets.

stderr.text: RuntimeError: async main cannot complete: no task can make progress

provenance.origin: authored for #342; Sparrow (Tomato) is the reference behaviour
provenance.expected_basis: #342: while a timer is pending the scheduler waits for it; after it fires, main's wait on an unset event can make no progress and the run fails at runtime.
